articles.title: Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders for personal use with monthly fee
articles.summary: Tesla is allowing select customers to pre-order the Cybercab for personal use, subject to geographic restrictions and a $299 monthly fee. Even Elon Musk admitted that the current monthly pricing structure feels too high for buyers.

articles.title: Nine settings make Apple's foldable iPhone Duo easier to use
articles.summary: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo comes with several interface challenges that can be mitigated through specific software adjustments. Users can configure Touch ID shortcuts, smarter volume buttons, and unique camera tricks to streamline their daily smartphone experience.

articles.title: Transportation secretary blames routine equipment upgrade for nationwide flight groundings
articles.summary: Following a massive nationwide grounding of flights, transportation officials confirmed the disruption stemmed from a routine equipment upgrade rather than any malicious cyberattack. The FAA administrator explicitly stated there was zero evidence pointing to artificial intelligence involvement.

articles.title: A running list of failed artificial intelligence projects and startups
articles.summary: The rapidly evolving artificial intelligence sector has left behind a trail of abandoned initiatives and shuttered startups. Notable casualties include Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI upgrades and OpenAI's complicated super app launch that ultimately failed to meet expectations.

articles.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's exit
articles.summary: The departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has prompted immediate reactions from various Asian governments. Authorities are scrambling to secure chip supply commitments, assess the impact on local technology projects, and address ongoing regulatory investigations in their regions.

articles.title: Amazon launches the premium Kindle Colorsoft e-reader
articles.summary: Amazon has introduced the Kindle Colorsoft, a lighter and thinner premium e-reader featuring an edge-to-edge color display. Despite the design improvements, owners of the first-generation model may find little incentive to upgrade given the high price tag.

articles.title: Jensen Huang's departure creates funding gap for AI startups
articles.summary: Venture capitalists and startup founders warn that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's exit will significantly disrupt AI funding. Under Huang, Nvidia invested tens of billions into startups, and his absence leaves the industry bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

articles.title: US government grounds all flights due to extraordinary circumstances
articles.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration temporarily grounded all flights across the United States following unexpected communication issues. The technical failures impacted multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers responsible for managing national airspace.

articles.title: Startup plans to power floating data centers using ocean heat
articles.summary: A young startup named Drogue is securing investor backing to harvest ocean heat to power data centers hosted on floating vessels. The company aims to deploy its first operational prototype in the water within the next two years.

articles.title: AI agent startup LangChain reaches $3 billion valuation
articles.summary: LangChain has achieved a $3 billion valuation on the back of its model-agnostic agent management platform, LangSmith. The company currently claims a robust client base of roughly 7,000 corporate customers utilizing its developer tools.

articles.title: China's powerful AI models trained on export-banned Nvidia chips
articles.summary: Recent research reveals that China's most advanced artificial intelligence models were trained using Nvidia chips that are currently banned for export. The finding raises fresh questions about the effectiveness of international trade restrictions on advanced semiconductors.

articles.title: ChatGPT introduces Wallet feature for automated AI agent shopping
articles.summary: OpenAI has rolled out a ChatGPT Wallet feature that enables AI agents to autonomously shop and complete checkouts on behalf of users. The capability is initially launching as a limited test for U.S. Pro subscribers.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering animated series coming to Netflix in 2027
articles.summary: Netflix is officially moving forward with an animated series based on Magic: The Gathering titled Planeswalker. Originally teased back in 2019, storytelling executives promise the project is finally on track for a 2027 release date.

articles.title: Copper wire replacement work caused nationwide FAA ground stop
articles.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy revealed that a nationwide flight ground stop resulted from routine maintenance replacing outdated copper wiring with fiber optics. The infrastructure work took place at a remote FAA facility rather than a major tech modernization project.

articles.title: REI launches massive holiday sale with early discounts
articles.summary: Major retailers continue to stretch the holiday shopping season by launching deep discounts well ahead of traditional shopping holidays. Outdoor enthusiasts can find early deals on camping gear, apparel, and travel equipment through REI's latest promotional event.

articles.title: OpenAI board member warns the public cannot trust AI CEOs
articles.summary: Helen Toner, an executive and former OpenAI board member known for firing Sam Altman, discusses the ongoing risks of artificial intelligence. She emphasizes the deep safety concerns surrounding governance and why humanity cannot blindly trust autonomous systems.

articles.title: Tesla offers personal Cybercab purchases with strict geographical limits
articles.summary: Tesla is giving select customers the opportunity to purchase a steering-wheel-free Cybercab for personal use. However, the autonomous two-seater will only function and remain available within strictly supported geographic service areas.

articles.title: Tiny gamepad with dual thumbsticks expands portable gaming limits
articles.summary: Portable gaming accessories continue to evolve to meet the ergonomic demands of modern players traveling with devices like the Nintendo Switch. Miniature controllers equipped with analog thumbsticks offer alternative control schemes for titles that demand precise inputs.

articles.title: Reviewing gadgets and apps designed to make homes smarter
articles.summary: Tech reviewers continue exploring various hardware and software products designed to modernize everyday households. Recent roundups highlight obscure apps, smart home automation tools, and productivity gadgets to simplify daily domestic routines.

articles.title: Reflecting on the era of visionary tech founder CEOs
articles.summary: Industry analysts are examining the changing archetype of the rockstar tech founder following high-profile public appearances by executives like Nvidia's Jensen Huang. These charismatic leaders have historically defined corporate culture, but their unique leadership style is evolving.

articles.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after hours of flight delays
articles.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration lifted a national ground stop that brought takeoffs across U.S. airports to a standstill for over four hours. Officials issued the emergency stop for safety reasons before gradually clearing commercial flights to resume normal schedules.

articles.title: Amazon plans to index global online shopping data
articles.summary: Amazon is reportedly developing a comprehensive database called the World Product Graph to catalog every product sold across the internet. The initiative aims to keep users on Amazon by providing expansive shopping details even for items the retailer does not stock.

articles.title: James Webb telescope discovers ice older than its host star
articles.summary: Astronomers analyzing data from the James Webb Space Telescope have identified ancient ice formations that predate the actual star they currently orbit. The discovery sheds light on how interstellar radiation and collisions shape planetary building blocks.

articles.title: Winemakers discover conservation practices improve business models
articles.summary: Vineyard owners are increasingly adopting sustainable farming techniques to protect their long-term agricultural investments. Implementing healthy soils, cultivating native plants, and reducing chemical usage are helping wine producers adapt to environmental shifts.

articles.title: SpaceX Starship flight 15 aims for orbital trajectory
articles.summary: SpaceX is preparing to launch its Starship flight 15 into orbit, setting the stage for potential booster catch attempts over the weekend. The flight test will provide engineers with critical operational data for future rocket recovery milestones.

articles.title: FAA issues rare nationwide ground stop due to obsolete hardware
articles.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy attributed a rare nationwide FAA ground stop to failures in outdated equipment. The incident marks only the third time in history that the agency has halted all domestic takeoffs due to infrastructure faults.

articles.title: Many Americans fail to take GLP-1 medications as prescribed
articles.summary: High financial costs and persistent supply chain barriers are leading millions of patients to alter their GLP-1 drug routines. Many consumers are resorting to modified dosages or seeking unapproved alternative versions due to tight access restrictions.

articles.title: FAA expands AI air traffic management tools across US airspace
articles.summary: The FAA is deploying artificial intelligence tools nationwide to help mitigate air traffic congestion and streamline flight paths. While commercial airlines have praised the technological upgrade, the union representing air traffic controllers reported they were excluded from the rollout.

articles.title: Ecological pressures threaten elephant populations in Sri Lanka
articles.summary: Environmental researchers report that shifting ecological conditions are placing severe limits on wildlife resilience in Sri Lanka. Ongoing habitat changes have contributed to a noticeable shrinking of the local park elephant population.

articles.title: Kalshi drops Trump Jr. as advisor over negative public optics
articles.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi has parted ways with Donald Trump Jr. as an advisor after executives acknowledged the poor public optics. The arrangement had previously drawn scrutiny as the Trump administration supported Kalshi in ongoing legal battles.

articles.title: OpenAI board member warns artificial intelligence takeover is possible
articles.summary: AI safety researchers warn that advanced language models could theoretically learn to exploit reward systems and outsmart human controllers. Experts argue that unchecked capability gains could eventually threaten human societal stability if safety guardrails fail.

articles.title: Windows SignDrop zero-day exploit grants hackers system privileges
articles.summary: A disgruntled researcher released a Windows zero-day vulnerability known as SignDrop that allows local users to elevate privileges to all-powerful system levels. The flaw exposes Windows machines to potential privilege escalation attacks by malicious actors.

articles.title: Global Microsoft outage disrupts critical infrastructure worldwide
articles.summary: A massive global Microsoft system outage left governments, hospitals, and courts scrambling to maintain operations. Industry experts suggest the sweeping technical failure rivaled or exceeded previous large-scale disruptions from tech firms like Amazon and CrowdStrike.

articles.title: Physicist's 1960 mathematical model predicted apocalyptic population crunch
articles.summary: In 1960, physicist Heinz von Foerster published a mathematical model predicting that exponential human population growth would eventually squeeze humanity to its limits. His historical hypothesis used demographic trends to forecast structural limits to global expansion.

articles.title: Understanding the function of uncommon yellow USB ports
articles.summary: Standard USB port color codes often carry specific technical meanings regarding power output and data transfer speeds. Yellow USB ports are relatively rare and typically indicate unique power-delivery capabilities designed to keep devices charged even when a computer sleeps.

articles.title: How to clear accumulated cache files on Samsung smart TVs
articles.summary: Samsung smart TVs store temporary cache files that can degrade performance and consume storage over time. Users can improve system responsiveness by periodically navigating the settings menu to clear out unneeded application data.
